g.title: cluster_legend_state
g.text: a state: what it runs, top to bottom

g.title: f0__start__0
g.text: The sha256 of the milestone body, which the run never writes, so a change is an operator's edit.

g.title: f0__complete__0
g.text: Whether the milestone body still matches *baseline*, and every work-list row not yet done.

g.title: f0__fill_story_splits__0
g.text: File every item of *kind* the ostler graph holds, satisfied ones as done, skipping ids already filed.

g.title: f0__fill_epics__0
g.text: File every item of *kind* the ostler graph holds, satisfied ones as done, skipping ids already filed.

g.title: f0__fill_stories__0
g.text: File every item of *kind* the ostler graph holds, satisfied ones as done, skipping ids already filed.

g.title: f0__split_epics__1
g.text: Whether the approved milestone already has a valid ordered epic split.

g.title: f0__start__1
g.text: Mint ids for every unnamed backlog bullet before decomposition or story lookup.

g.title: f0__start__2
g.text: Register ONE bullet as a new story inside an already-existing epic.

g.title: f0__start__6
g.text: Remove the one backlog bullet story mode consumed — story mode's tail.

g.title: f1__start__0
g.text: Decide whether the granularity planner needs its one bounded judgment.

g.title: f1__assess__0
g.text: Assess one unit against the rubric

g.title: f1__check__0
g.text: Check one unit's finding record, hard and deterministically.

g.title: f1__split__0
g.text: Replace a too-big folder unit with its immediate children.

g.title: f1__check__1
g.text: Stamp the unit's inventory entry with its (validated) record's status.

g.title: f1__fix__0
g.text: Repair a finding record so it validates

g.title: f1__pick__0
g.text: The first unit still `pending`, or the news that none is left.

g.title: f1__emit__0
g.text: Write the generated backlog bullets and the unit-level manifest.

g.title: f1__expand__0
g.text: Materialize the unit inventory from the enumeration rules — then freeze it.

g.title: f1__partition__0
g.text: Partition the finding records into epic/story candidates

g.title: f1__partition__1
g.text: Every non-clean unit maps into at least one cluster, and no cluster invents units.

g.title: f1__pick__0->f1__assess__0
g.text: unit_id, unit_path, unit_kind, record_path, progress, verify_resolve

g.title: f1__verify__0
g.text: The coverage gate: every frozen unit accounted for, and no silent shrinkage.

g.title: f1__split__1
g.text: Stamp the unit's inventory entry with its (validated) record's status.

g.title: f2__start__0
g.text: Freeze one survey unit per baseline surface.

g.title: f2__assess__0
g.text: Compare one baseline surface with the current OKF book

g.title: f2__mark__0
g.text: Check one unit's finding record, hard and deterministically.

g.title: f2__emit__0
g.text: One backlog bullet per assessed surface that no new-app feature already owns.

g.title: f2__mark__1
g.text: Stamp the unit's inventory entry with its (validated) record's status.

g.title: f2__pick__0
g.text: The first unit still `pending`, or the news that none is left.

g.title: f2__verify__0
g.text: The coverage gate: every frozen unit accounted for, and no silent shrinkage.

g.title: f3__start__0
g.text: Capture the graph and story-body baseline an edit is allowed to change.

g.title: f3__apply_plan__0
g.text: Apply one validated plan idempotently through Ostler's structural APIs.

g.title: f3__apply_plan__1
g.text: Prove disk matches the approved graph and unaffected story bodies remain byte-stable.

g.title: f3__finish__0
g.text: `ostler doctor` over the whole graph, as a blocking gate.

g.text: Rewrite epic prose after an approved graph edit

g.title: f3__next_affected_story__0
g.text: Resolve the next approved affected story without widening the edit worklist.

g.title: f3__rework_story__0
g.text: Append this attempt's failure to the story's attempts ledger, and read it back.

g.text: Adequacy review: do `{{ workhorse_var('epic') }}`'s stories cover the epic?

g.text: Design a mockup for a new screen: `{{ workhorse_var('story_slug') }}`

g.text: Commit the epic/story docs this run wrote, in the one repo it wrote them in.

g.title: f3__finish__2
g.text: Remove the one backlog bullet story mode consumed — story mode's tail.

g.title: f3__plan_edit__0
g.text: Plan an edit to epic `{{ workhorse_var('snapshot').epic }}`

g.title: f6__author_epic__1

g.title: f7__check_coverage__0

g.text: Adequacy review: do `{{ workhorse_var('epic') }}`'s stories cover the epic?

g.title: f8__start__0
g.text: Resolve exactly ``epic/story`` and give its document every required section it lacks.

g.text: Adversarially audit a story for coder-readiness: `{{ workhorse_var('story_slug') }}`
